exchangeFormat: Prairies (VE/VA 4/5/6 = MB/SK/AB): RST + 3-letter federal-electoral-district code. Outside: RST + 2-letter state/province or 'DX'. Bands 40-20-15-10m. CW/Phone only. Prairie stations work everyone; outside works prairie only (non-prairie↔non-prairie no credit).

scoringRules.scoreFormula: Σ QSO pts × Σ mults, mults counted ONCE PER BAND (4 bands). Pts: 1 per CW or Phone QSO. Prairie entrant mult = each US state (50) + each Canadian area (13) per band; non-prairie↔outside contacts give the worked station's 2-letter state/prov. Non-prairie entrant mult = distinct prairie districts per band (62). Prairie works everyone (incl DX = 1 pt, NO mult); non-prairie scores prairie contacts only (non-prairie↔non-prairie no credit). Rovers/district-line = new QSO + new district. Claimed/running — the CPQP committee re-adjudicates. CLAIMED APPROXIMATION: the official 62-district→province table is NOT in the published rules, so the prairie↔prairie per-province multiplier (the 3 prairie provinces among the 13 Canadian areas, 'including their own province') is approximated as ONE per-band 'PRAIRIE' area multiplier — under-counts by ≤2 areas/band vs the true MB/SK/AB split; the committee re-adjudicates from the official district list. NOT applied (off-log): power/category.
